svg.title: A Small Worm and a Borrowed Star
svg.desc: A fantastical worm drawing emphasizes broad compressed body masses, folded neck anatomy, strong cross-contour shading and curling horn silhouettes around a skull-like head. This original child-friendly scene keeps the weight, segmentation and curling silhouette while replacing the horror face with curiosity. Exactly 7.000 s, continuous loop: 0–0.84 s curious pause; 0.84–1.68 s head inclines −3° while feelers coil inward; 1.68–3.78 s head tilts 6° toward the approaching firefly, the two feelers open with different amplitudes; 3.78–5.04 s gaze and smile hold while feelers settle later; 5.04–7.00 s firefly, head and feelers return along smooth closed tracks. The grounded body stays weight-bearing.
svg.text: A SMALL WORM AND A BORROWED STAR
